visual_thesis: A coding harness can be assembled from replaceable capabilities; Agent Skills is one capability rather than the entire agent.
mechanism_metaphor: An asymmetrical radial letterpress rosette with a large open Harness ring at center. Six unequal detachable lobes name Coding, Sandbox, MCP, Tracing, Memory and Agent Skills. Each is visibly separable with a clean gap and no toggle or knob. Agent Skills is a large lower-left booklet lobe with exactly Tools and Instructions on its front meaningful surfaces; do not invent code or simulated lettering. A single arrow travels from the physical Agent Skills lobe into the harness attachment port to indicate adding the capability. All other module connections are plain nondirectional fitted joints. A small outer Model leaf at top-right attaches through a nondirectional stem. The detached bottom-right caveat is Beta; single-run benchmarks. Show the core loop open through the ring, a file/shell workspace edge as an unmarked fitted interface, and a tracing spine without decorative metrics. No unsupported automatic restart in Pax or claim of superior performance. No cream plaque board, no six equal boxes, no generic dashboard.
story_anchors: Reusable capabilities provide tools, instructions and hooks; Pax composes plugins including Agent Skills, coding, workspace and tracing.
The beta supports replaceable models and harnesses; performance evidence is single first-party runs.
